conditioning_and_probability_space.conditioning: Fix the retained candidate snapshot: curve/group, targets, all observed points and traces, definedness mask and anchor requirement, measured legal distinct nonzero candidate budget M for each cell, and namespace identifiers. No conditioning on a reference hit, an attractive orientation statistic, or a selected seed is permitted.
conditioning_and_probability_space.random_variable: Host reference output is a deterministic function of the host master seed and the fixed conditioned snapshot. A probability statement requires an explicit distribution/model for that seed and the SHA256 stream; deterministic replay alone establishes no random-source property.
conditioning_and_probability_space.physical_seed_ensemble_limit: For a fixed real deterministic implementation and fixed snapshot, at most 2^256 different complete output sequences are possible as the 32-byte master varies. With the realized seed fixed there is one sequence. Full uniform orientation support and iid stream claims below refer to an ideal uniform-draw/hash model, not a proved fact about this finite deterministic generator.
conditioning_and_probability_space.separation: Worker nonce is one32-byte draw before candidate sampling. Host master is a different declared32-byte draw after candidate queries, collection/seal/quiescence/ACK/authentication. The frozen event order is a specification to check against retained events; it does not itself prove fresh entropy or independence.
conditioning_and_probability_space.scope: Conditional descriptive references, no exchangeable inferential null, no p-value or candidate advantage conclusion.

seed_domains_and_underdetermination.worker_preimage_as_specified: nonce || NUL || transfer-study/v1/role || NUL || draw_id || u64_counter
seed_domains_and_underdetermination.host_seed_mapping_as_specified: K_namespace = SHA256(master || namespace), with namespaces null/{curve_id} and uniform/{cell_id}; reference-local domains are delegated to unread reference.py.
seed_domains_and_underdetermination.domain_argument: Fixed32-byte master fixes the master/namespace boundary. Distinct literal null/ and uniform/ prefixes separate those namespace families if their encodings and IDs are preserved. Distinct namespace inputs imply distinct hash inputs, not mathematically guaranteed distinct digests. Check duplicate IDs and complete preimage bytes, not just displayed seeds.
seed_domains_and_underdetermination.ideal_model: Under an ideal-hash model distinct preimages have independent uniform256-bit digests; repeated preimages repeat exactly. A common real master and domain separation do not constitute independent physical entropy for every curve/cell/stage.

seed_domains_and_underdetermination.boundary: Do not guess delegated details or claim an independent blind byte prediction from this underspecified statement. After actual committed release/root ACK, transcribe exact source byte rules independently without imports/calls and test their mathematical law plus retained outputs; identify that source-based transcription separately from this blind derivation.

unbiased_integer_reduction.variables: Bound b>=1, proposal width w bytes, R=256^w, uniform proposal U in{0,...,R-1}, with b<=R.
unbiased_integer_reduction.threshold_construction: T=b*floor(R/b)=R-(R mod b). Reject U>=T; return U mod b otherwise.
unbiased_integer_reduction.proof: For every residue j in0..b-1 exactly floor(R/b) integers below T map to j. Thus P(result=j|accepted)=1/b. Repeated independent proposals retain this law; every rejected proposal consumes work. A bit-width/bitmask accept-below-b construction can also be unbiased and must be assessed as its own source branch.
unbiased_integer_reduction.naive_modulo_failure: If R mod b !=0, residues below R mod b have floor(R/b)+1 preimages and the rest floor(R/b); direct modulo reduction is biased.
unbiased_integer_reduction.accounting: Separate stream requests, digest blocks/bytes, bounded-integer proposals, threshold rejections, accepted bounded values, duplicate/nonzero rejections, and final stored values. These are different units. Consumption cannot be inferred from accepted count alone.
unbiased_integer_reduction.undefined_cases: b<=0 is invalid; b=1 is a constant result but raw consumption is implementation-defined unless specified; widths b>R need a widened/repeated representation, not this single-width formula.

exact_mask_orientation_law.formal_definition: For an odd-prime nonzero scalar domain, an eligible symmetric definedness mask is a disjoint union of D pairs{a,-a}. A binary orientation assigns complementary values on each defined pair. Pin one anchor pair to its required complementary labels; the other D-1 orientations are free. This makes explicit the interpretation needed for the frozen2^(D-1) law, without guessing the actual anchor ID or packing.
exact_mask_orientation_law.support: |Omega(mask,anchors)|=2^(D-1), for D>=1 and valid both-anchor symmetric mask. Each free bit vector corresponds bijectively to one labeled orientation.
exact_mask_orientation_law.conditions: Both anchors must be present and consistent; definedness preserved at each sign. An asymmetric mask, missing/undefined anchor, or contradictory anchor constraints is ineligible; retain that case with no replacement mask/curve/seed. Zero is a self-negative scalar and is outside this pair argument; its source handling remains to be inspected.
exact_mask_orientation_law.degenerate_case: D=1 gives support1 and no free orientation bits. Every valid draw then has the same orientation; actual PRNG consumption is not fixed by the blind specification.
exact_mask_orientation_law.sampling: For each eligible calibration curve, K=1023 draws WITH replacement from the orientation support under the ideal uniform-draw model. Every ordered K-tuple has mass support^(-K). In general duplicates are valid; count each original draw.
exact_mask_orientation_law.multiplicity_identity: For multiplicity m(o) of every stored unique orientation o: m(o)>=1 and sum_o m(o)=1023. For any statistic g, the empirical sum is sum_o m(o)*g(o), not sum_o g(o). Preserve source draw indices, byte/bit lengths, padding, duplicates and tied statistic values.
exact_mask_orientation_law.ties_and_conditioning: A tied statistic does not identify a duplicate orientation. A duplicate orientation must retain each occurrence and its index/weight. No rejection/resampling based on statistic, equality to observed labels or reference success is justified by the frozen law.
exact_mask_orientation_law.randomness_limit: If D-1>256, exact full uniform support over all2^(D-1) orientations cannot follow solely from a fixed deterministic algorithm and a uniformly selected256-bit real seed. The symbolic support describes the ideal conditional ensemble; report that model explicitly.

matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.variables: Prime group order r; N=r-1; fixed truth x in{1,...,N}; M is the observed number of distinct legal nonzero candidate scalars for the conditioned cell; m=min(M,N).
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.law: Sample an ordered m-tuple of distinct elements of{1,...,N} uniformly without replacement. Each ordered tuple has probability1/(N)_m; the induced subset is uniform over binomial(N,m) subsets.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.hit_probability_derivation: For0<=m<=N, P(x included | fixed snapshot,M)=binomial(N-1,m-1)/binomial(N,m)=m/N, with the m=0 value0. Equivalently P(miss)=(N-m)/N by cancellation of the sequential avoidance product.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.assumption: The uniformity is conditional on the retained M, truth and fixed snapshot, requiring an independent ideal host stream. Candidate data determine M; selecting M or the seed after seeing the reference hit changes the conditioning and need not preserve m/N.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.duplicate_rejection_argument: Given j already selected distinct scalars, a uniform proposal in1..N accepted only if new is uniform on the N-j remaining values. Repeating until m accepted therefore produces the ordered law. Preserve every rejected duplicate and all raw bounded-integer rejection work.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.replacement_comparison: m iid draws WITH replacement instead give P(hit)=1-(1-1/N)^m; it is not m/N for general m. Duplicate draws do not increase the number of distinct legal candidates.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.boundaries: M=0: empty list, hitfalse, no imputed guess. M>=N: exactly N distinct nonzero guesses and saturation hittrue for a valid nonzero target; clamp m before sampling so no impossible extra-distinct loop. Zero is not in the sample domain and cannot spend one of the m guesses.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.coverage_checks: Every retained cell needs exact domain/uniqueness/length, saturation/empty status, stored order, public check truth, complete consumed proposal/rejection sequence, budget provenance and stream namespace. A branch with no retained case remains untested by retained-data replay.
matched_budget_nonzero_without_replaceme.cost_boundary: This is conditional same-domain/list-budget comparison, not a standalone solver. M-determination, all candidate zero/duplicate checks, host generation/rejection/checks and setup/memory remain paid or explicitly unknown. A success indicator does not qualify those costs.

dependence_and_population_units.dependence: The six cells reuse the same retained target Q, blinding b, trace length L and trace, with nested radius/erasure settings and data-dependent budgets. Distinct uniform namespace streams can be independent only conditionally under an ideal-hash model; cell observations and budgets are shared nested diagnostics and cannot be counted as independent scientific trials.
dependence_and_population_units.target_nesting: 64 distinct Q per confirmation curve, eight nonzero blindings per Q, six decoder cells per attempt. Shared Q across eight blindings does not create eight unique targets. Distinct calibration curves/stages share the single worker nonce and host master; domain separation is not a physical independence measurement.
dependence_and_population_units.retry_formula: S_curve+T_target+E[C_complete_online]/q is justified only for iid fresh COMPLETE restarts under stated fixed conditions and q>0. Repeated retained cells/shared targets or observed zero hits do not establish this restart law or q=0. Observed zero gives an undefined/null retry-cost estimate in this scope.
